protocol.selection: Minimum validation RMSE among policies with validation mean terminalized cost <= 0.50 per initial spot 100
protocol.no_feasible_rule: Choose minimum validation cost, label fallback and retain budget violation
protocol.tie_break: RMSE, mean_cost, then policy name lexicographically
protocol.primary_contrast: S1 at 5 bps: selected policy versus every5 on paired squared terminal losses
protocol.primary_interval: Pointwise two-sided 95% t interval over independent paired test paths
protocol.other_contrasts: Exploratory pointwise intervals; no familywise claim
protocol.premium: Identical BS(base_vol=0.2) premium for all scenarios and policies; not repriced with hidden path parameters
protocol.claims: Discrete hypothetical replication under stated conventions; no executable trading or causal market evidence

numerical.interpretation: MC error is random, not necessarily monotone; CRR subsequence is even-step. Timing single-process, one run per size, descriptive only.

limitations: Scenario-specific validation choice is not a universal optimal policy.
Confidence intervals are pointwise; all but one prespecified contrast exploratory.
Mean validation cost feasibility does not guarantee test or per-path budget feasibility.
Terminal loss includes initial premium, financing, entry/rebalance/exit costs and payoff.
No market quote calibration, margin, liquidity or execution model.
